# Documentation issue / 文档问题

Do not put a private security report in a public issue. Follow the private
instructions in [SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md) or its
[Simplified Chinese counterpart](../../SECURITY.zh-CN.md).

不要在公开 issue 中提交私密安全报告。请遵循
[SECURITY.md](../../SECURITY.md) 或其
[简体中文版本](../../SECURITY.zh-CN.md)中的私密说明。

## Required confirmations / 必需确认

- [ ] No credential or private data is included. / 未包含 credential 或私人数据。
- [ ] I checked both language versions when relevant. / 适用时，我已检查两个语言版本。
- [ ] This issue is not a private security report. / 此 issue 不是私密安全报告。

## Affected file or page / 受影响的文件或页面

## Language / 语言

<!-- English, Simplified Chinese, or both? / 英文、简体中文，还是两者？ -->

## Inaccurate or unclear statement / 不准确或不清晰的表述

## Expected correction / 预期更正

## Runnable example impact / 可运行示例影响

<!-- State whether a runnable example is affected. / 请说明是否影响可运行示例。 -->

## Link or anchor status / Link 或 anchor 状态

<!-- Identify any broken link or anchor. / 请指出任何失效的 link 或 anchor。 -->

## Security or trust-boundary impact / Security 或 trust-boundary 影响

<!-- State whether a security or trust-boundary statement is affected. / 请说明是否影响 security 或 trust-boundary 表述。 -->

## Sanitized reproduction, when applicable / 适用时提供脱敏复现

<!-- Include no credential, private data, or unredacted absolute path. / 不得包含 credential、私人数据或未脱敏的绝对路径。 -->
